`final class GlStateGuard`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.state` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlStateGuard.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/state/GlStateGuard.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Saves the OpenGL state that JOID changes during a frame and gives it back to the host when the frame ends.

## Description

Entries nest: only the outermost `enter()` starts the journal and resets the pipeline for JOID, and only the matching `exit()` restores the state of the host.

## Learn more

- [The state journal](/build/embedding-in-a-host/#the-state-journal)
- [base-opengl](/build/base-modules/opengl/)

## Method details

<a id="GlStateGuard-method-enter"></a>

### enter

`void enter()` 

Enters the guard; the outermost entry starts the journal and resets what a host may leave on: scissor, smooth lines, logic op, polygon offset, sRGB, primitive restart, depth clamp, the fixed pipeline, the clear values, the faces, the line width and the pixel storage.

<a id="GlStateGuard-method-exit"></a>

### exit

`void exit()` 

Leaves the guard; the outermost exit writes back every state that JOID changed since `enter()`.

<a id="GlStateGuard-method-run"></a>

### run

`void run(Runnable action)` 

Runs the action between `enter()` and `exit()`.

<a id="GlStateGuard-method-call"></a>

### call

`<T> T call(Supplier<T> action)` 

Returns the result of the action, run between `enter()` and `exit()`.

<a id="GlStateGuard-method-suspend"></a>

### suspend

`void suspend(Runnable draw)` 

Gives the host its state back, runs the drawing of the host outside the guard, then enters again with the same depth.

<a id="GlStateGuard-method-getBinding"></a>

### getBinding

`IGlBinding getBinding()` 

Returns the journaled binding through which every call must go.
